improvement.name: Collision-safe evidence-history cache invalidation
improvement.problem: A same-size agent-summary.json rewrite could retain the same observable filesystem stat tuple long enough for the process-local evidence-history cache to return stale parsed state.
implementation: Preserve the complete uncapped 32-worker evidence-history scan and process-local parse cache.
Use a non-persistent recursive evidence-root watcher on Linux and other supported hosts to invalidate changed agent-summary.json entries.
Use non-recursive per-summary file watchers on Windows after real Node 24.19.0 CI exposed instability in recursive fs.watch during benchmark-tree teardown.
Advance a watcher epoch and rescan when mutation is observed during a list operation.
Fall back to exact byte comparison before same-stat cache reuse whenever watching is unavailable or unhealthy.
Retain structured-clone isolation, malformed/incomplete skip behavior, deletion pruning, chronological results and all evidence files.
acceptance: Deterministically freeze the old summary stat tuple across a same-size passed-to-failed rewrite and require the repaired cache to return the current bytes while the legacy stat-only control reproduces stale data.
Maintain at least 35% median and 30% p95 gain versus direct reads on the 2,000-run history fixture on both Linux and Windows.
Pass the complete Ferrum severe runtime matrix on the exact final proposal head without reducing timeouts, evidence, browsers, targets or tests.

benchmark.forcedStatCollision: legacy stat-only cache returned stale passed; repaired cache returned current failed on both platforms

coverage: unit tests, syntax, shell checks, MCP surface and independent MCP Inspector, evidence integrity
independent Brave and Opera GX, real Selenium Grid WebDriver, Lightpanda and real Android/Appium
cross-platform evidence-history collision benchmark plus Perfetto, service fixture, stateful API and network-fault companion verification

risk.summary: Filesystem watcher behavior is platform-specific, so exact-byte fallback remains the correctness backstop when watcher coverage is unavailable or unhealthy.
risk.rollback: Revert the cache invalidation/watch changes as one coherent unit only if a later exact runtime regression cannot be fixed forward; do not restore stat-only reuse without the deterministic collision regression.
